notes.title: v1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Adds a Staff Credits button to the Title Screen.
- Fixes a possible softlock during Otto's Balltimate awakening cutscene.

notes.title: v1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Enables more resolution options, regardless of what the system declares as available.
- Reduces overall difficulty during the Defense Challenges.
- Reduces overall difficulty during the Underground Tournament.
- Makes it so the Daily Challenger marker becomes hidden after the task is done for the day.
- Fixes softlock in challenges when the Damage Taken difficulty option is set to 0%.
- Fixes some rules for when the Focus Ability is allowed to be used, especially during free-field battles.

notes.title: v1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Adds more resolution options, including 1440p.
- Makes it so the directional buttons on a controller can also be used for movement.
- Fixes the All Geared Up achievement, so it now unlocks properly under all circumstances. If you already meet the requirements and the achievement hasn't unlocked yet, please try buying any common item at the Cafeteria.
- Fixes a bug when activating a Balltimate move if the opponent was switching players in tag-mode battles.
- Fixes an oversight where Otto could be left alone in the team with 0 HP during Episode 5.
- Fixes an oversight in the Impulse Purchase sidequest, if you already had purchased every Equipment from the Dodge Shop.
- Fixes an oversight in Episode 8 where a late-game cutscene played repeatedly even after the event was complete.
- Fixes an oversight with the interaction button icon when using a Nintendo controller on PC.
